verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only an in-product draft/publish lifecycle. Edits stay in a draft and do not affect the published flow until you click Publish. Projects marked Sensitive add an approval gate before publishing. This is a basic form of change control, but nothing in the pack covers source control or promotion across environments. Missing for 10: Git/source-control sync of flows, dev/staging/prod environments, a dev-to-production promotion workflow, version history or rollback, and independent corroboration.
